package redact

// Generator of go-oracle.json: what the frozen Go build computes for the
// inputs of the TypeScript port's redaction tests. The Go code is frozen, so
// this is kept as text. To regenerate at the freeze commit: copy it to
// internal/redact/zz_oracle_test.go, run
// go test -count=1 -run TestZZOracle ./internal/redact, delete the copy.

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/render"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset/resultsettest"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/schema"
)

type envCase struct {
	Name, Value string
	Rule        string
}

type selectCase struct {
	Env     map[string]string
	Values  []string
	Sources map[string]string
	Left    []string
}

type stringCase struct {
	Text string
	Out  string
	N    int
}

type bytesCase struct {
	In  string // base64
	Out string // base64
	N   int
}

type npmrcCase struct {
	In     string   // base64
	Values []string // base64 each, Go strings may hold any bytes
}

type artifactOut struct {
	Path     string
	Redacted bool
	Content  string // base64
}

type caseMap struct {
	In, Lower, Upper string
}

func b64(s string) string { return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }

func ptrTo[T any](v T) *T { return &v }

func TestZZOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := map[string]any{"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8"}

	// LooksLikeSecret / secretRule on inputs where Go and JavaScript differ:
	// Unicode case folding, Unicode white space, byte lengths.
	envInputs := [][2]string{
		{"API_KEY", "\u017fample"},           // long s folds to s in (?i)
		{"API_KEY", "SAMPLE"},
		{"X", "ye\u017f"},                    // plain value with long s
		{"API_KEY", "moc\u212a"},             // Kelvin sign folds to k
		{"API_KEY", "\u0130\u0130\u0130\u0130"}, // dotted capital I: Go lowers to i
		{"API_KEY", "\u03a3\u03a3\u03a3\u03a3"}, // capital sigma
		{"API_KEY", "\u03c3\u03c2\u03c3\u03c2"}, // sigma and final sigma
		{"API_KEY", "\u0085token-value\u0085"},  // NEL is white space in Go
		{"API_KEY", "\ufeffempty"},              // BOM is not white space in Go
		{"API_KEY", "\u00a0empty\u00a0"},        // NBSP is white space in Go
		{"API_KEY", "\u3000empty"},
		{"PA\u00dfWORD", "value12"},             // sharp s has no simple upper case
		{"pa\u017f\u017fword", "value12"},       // long s upper-cases to S
		{"TO\ufb00KEN", "value12"},
		{"\u0131auth", "value12"},               // dotless i upper-cases to I
		{"X", "\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc"},
		{"X", "\u00c4bcdefGh1234"},
		{"X", "Abcdefgh12\u00e9"},               // 11 characters, 12 bytes
		{"API_KEY", "\u00e4\u00f6"},             // 2 characters, 4 bytes
		{"API_KEY", "ab"},
		{"X", "\uff11\uff12\uff13\uff14\uff15"}, // full-width digits
		{"X", "12345"},
		{"X", "123456"},
		{"X", "https://\u00fcser:p\u00e4ssword@host/x"},
		{"X", "a://b@c"},
		{"X", "-----BEGIN "},
		{"X", "abc.def-ghi:jkl_mno1"},
		{"X", "abc.def-ghi:jkl.mno1"},
		{"X", "\u2028secret-Token-1234\u2028"},
		{"X", "aB3dE6gH9jK2mN5p"},
		{"X", "aB3dE6gH9jK2mN5\U0001F600"},
		{"X", "\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600"},
		{"API_KEY", "\U0001F600"},
		{"X", "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9"},
		{"X", "abcdefghijklmnop"},
		{"X", "abcdefghijklmno1"},
		{"X", "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO1"},
		{"X", "line one\nline two"},
		{"X", "http://a b@c"},
		{"X", "x://u@h\tmore://v@w"},
		{"AUTH", "  "},
		{"auth", "\u0130"},
		{"X", "TRUE"},
		{"X", "\u0074\u0072\u0075\u0065"},
		{"API_KEY", "N/A"},
		{"API_KEY", "n/a!"},
		{"API_KEY", "xXxX"},
		{"X", "Xk9fK3mQx7TzLw2VbN8s"},
		{"X", "Qm7vR2xKp9LzT4wYb8NcJ3dH"},
	}
	var envCases []envCase
	for _, in := range envInputs {
		envCases = append(envCases, envCase{Name: in[0], Value: in[1], Rule: secretRule(in[0], in[1])})
	}
	out["env"] = envCases

	envMaps := []map[string]string{
		{
			"Z": "aB3dE6gH9jK2mN5p", "a": "hello", "\u00e9": "x", "\U0001F600": "y-plain",
			"\ue000": "aB3dE6gH9jK2mN5q", "API_TOKEN": "aB3dE6gH9jK2mN5p",
		},
		{
			"CERT_PRIVATE_KEY": "line-one-secret\u0085  line-two-secret\r\n\nxy\r",
			"SPACED_SECRET":    "two \u00a0words\u2028here",
			"MULTI":            "a\rb\rc\rlonger-line-AB12!",
		},
		{
			"DB_URL":  "postgres://us\u00e9r:p\u00e4ss@db/app?token=abcd1234efgh&x=1#f",
			"HOOK":    "see https://h.example/T0123Abc9xYz/x?k=v https://u:pw99@m.example/a b",
			"EMPTYQS": "postgres://u:pw@h/?#",
		},
		{
			"GREETING": "hello", "CACHE_HOST": "store.internal", "PATH_PREFIX": "src/billing/",
			"REPORT_SIGNING": "Xk9fK3mQx7TzLw2VbN8s",
		},
		{"SOME_SECRET_KEY": "empty", "STORE_TOKEN": "Qm7vR2xKp9LzT4wYb8NcJ3dH"},
		{"DB_PASSWORD": "root", "AUTH_REALM": "confirmed", "SIGNING_KEY": "primary", "SESSION_SECRET": "parse", "API_TOKEN": "syntax"},
	}
	var selects []selectCase
	for _, env := range envMaps {
		sel := SelectEnv(env)
		selects = append(selects, selectCase{Env: env, Values: sel.Values, Sources: sel.Sources, Left: sel.Left})
	}
	out["selectEnv"] = selects

	// Spellings and the order in which they are replaced.
	sp := New()
	sp.Add("pa\"ss\\word-12345", "tab\there-123", "<html>&co", "line\u2028sep", "\U0001F600\U0001F600", "\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc",
		"ab\u0007cd", "abcd", "abce", "\ue000abc", "\U00010000ab", "\u00e9\u00e9", "new\nline", "a\u2029b")
	sp.AddTextOnly("dcba", "\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc", "x\ty\tz")
	var forms []string
	for _, f := range sp.forms(false) {
		forms = append(forms, f.text)
	}
	var everywhere []string
	for _, f := range sp.forms(true) {
		everywhere = append(everywhere, f.text)
	}
	out["forms"] = forms
	out["formsEverywhere"] = everywhere

	// String on texts with multi-byte characters around and inside the values.
	sr := New()
	sr.Add("s3cr3t-v\u00e4lue", "\U0001F600\U0001F600", "abab", "token-abcdef", "token-abcdef-extended", "[REDACTED]x", "ACTED]")
	var strs []stringCase
	for _, text := range []string{
		"\u00e4s3cr3t-v\u00e4lue\u00f6",
		"\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600",
		"ababab abababab",
		"x token-abcdef-extended y token-abcdef z",
		"\U0001F600s3cr3t-v\u00e4lue\U0001F600 s3cr3t-v\\u00e4lue",
		"[REDACTED]x and [REDACTED]",
		"nothing here",
		"",
	} {
		o, n := sr.String(text)
		strs = append(strs, stringCase{Text: text, Out: o, N: n})
	}
	out["strings"] = strs

	// Bytes on contents with invalid UTF-8 next to the values.
	var bs []bytesCase
	for _, in := range [][]byte{
		[]byte("\xffs3cr3t-v\u00e4lue\xfe"),
		[]byte("\xf0\x9f\x98\x80\xf0\x9f\x98\x80\xf0\x9f\x98"),
		[]byte("\xe4s3cr3t-v\xc3\xa4lue"),
		[]byte("abab\x00abab\x80abab"),
		[]byte("{\"v\":\"s3cr3t-v\u00e4lue\"}"),
		[]byte("clean"),
	} {
		o, n := sr.Bytes(append([]byte(nil), in...))
		bs = append(bs, bytesCase{In: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(in), Out: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(o), N: n})
	}
	out["bytes"] = bs

	// NpmrcValues, base64 decoding included.
	var npm []npmrcCase
	for _, in := range []string{
		"//r/:_authToken=tok-abc\n//r/:_password=" + b64("pass\u00e4word") + "\n//r/:_auth=" + b64("u:p\u00e4ss:x") + "\n",
		"//r/:_password=YWJj\n//r/:_password=YWJjZA\n//r/:_password=YWJjZA==\n//r/:_password=YW Jj\n",
		"//r/:_password=YW\rJjZA==\n//r/:_auth=dTpw\n//r/:_auth=dXNlcg==\n",
		"//r/:_password=/w==\n//r/:_password=YWJjZA=\n//r/:_password=YWJjZA===\n//r/:_password=YQ=a\n//r/:_password=YWJ-\n",
		"//r/:_password=YWJjZB==\n//r/:_auth=\"'dTpw'\"\n  ; c\n\t# c\n//r/:_authToken = ${X}-y\n_authToken\nk=v=w_authToken\n",
		"//r/:_authToken=\u00a0tok-xyz\u00a0\n\u0085//r/:_authToken=t2\r\n//r/:_authToken=\"\"\n",
		"\xff//r/:_authToken=bad\xfebytes\n",
	} {
		var vals []string
		for _, v := range NpmrcValues([]byte(in)) {
			vals = append(vals, b64(v))
		}
		npm = append(npm, npmrcCase{In: b64(in), Values: vals})
	}
	out["npmrc"] = npm

	// The hostile golden set, redacted.
	h := resultsettest.Hostile()
	hr := New()
	hr.AddFrom("gitleaks", "a|b.js", "\U0001F600\U0001F600\U0001F600", "cdef0123", "test/a.js")
	hr.AddTextOnlyFrom(".env", "line2\ttabbed", "alert(1)", "scripts.test", "<b>html</b>", "C-0002", "tool_output", "node --check", "``double``", "not a list")
	count := hr.Apply(h)
	doc, err := render.JSON(h)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var arts []artifactOut
	for _, a := range h.Artifacts {
		arts = append(arts, artifactOut{Path: a.Path, Redacted: a.Redacted, Content: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(a.Content)})
	}
	out["hostile"] = map[string]any{"count": count, "report": string(doc), "artifacts": arts,
		"explain": hr.Explain([]string{
			"/findings/0/title: x", "/findings/0/locations/0/path: y", "/findings/1/locations/0/path: y",
			"/findings/0/evidence: z", "/test_cases/0: w", "/artifacts/1/content: q", "/run/status: v", "no pointer",
			"/findings/0/evidence/0/text: a", "/findings/0/evidence/1/text: a",
		})}

	// Explain on the populated fixture.
	pr := New()
	pr.AddTextOnlyFrom("env-secret-name (.env DB_PASSWORD)", "hunter2-made-up-value")
	pr.AddFrom("gitleaks", "ghp_madeUpTokenForTheTest0123456789abcd")
	pr.Add("unnamed-made-up-value")
	ps := resultsettest.Populated()
	ps.Findings[0].Title = "login with hunter2-made-up-value"
	ps.Findings[0].Message = "token ghp_madeUpTokenForTheTest0123456789abcd leaked unnamed-made-up-value"
	ps.Checks[0].Reason = ptrTo("fine")
	pcount := pr.Apply(ps)
	out["populated"] = map[string]any{"count": pcount, "explain": pr.Explain([]string{
		"/findings/0/title: something is wrong",
		"/findings/0/locations/0/path_base: value must be 'project_root'",
		"/checks/0/reason: another problem",
		"/findings/0: object problem",
		"/findings/0/message: m",
		"execution number 1 has ID \"x\", want \"E-0001\"",
	})}

	// strings.ToLower and strings.ToUpper, for the shared helpers.
	var cases []caseMap
	for _, in := range []string{
		"Hello World", "\u0130stanbul", "\u03a3\u039f\u03a3", "stra\u00dfe", "\ufb00\ufb01", "\u017f\u212a\u0131",
		"\u0149\u01f0", "\u1f80\u1f88", "\u0345", "\u01c5\u01c4\u01c6", "\U00010400\U00010428", "\u2c65\u023a",
		"I\u0307", "\u1e9e", "\u0587",
	} {
		cases = append(cases, caseMap{In: in, Lower: strings.ToLower(in), Upper: strings.ToUpper(in)})
	}
	out["caseMapping"] = cases

	closed := []string{}
	for p := range schema.ClosedPaths() {
		closed = append(closed, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(closed)
	out["closedPaths"] = closed

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/go-oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
